Lupine Social Ecology, module Religion. The Faith of Fenris is NOT a centralized religion like Catholicism; it is a decentralized network of communities guided by elders and tradition-keepers.

HIERARCHY: High Fang (supreme spiritual authority, extremely rare, often unfilled) > Moon Speakers (priests/theologians/ceremony leaders) > Keepers (custodians of relics, sacred sites, oral tradition) > Pack Elders (local spiritual guides within each pack) > The Faithful (all believing werewolves).

HIGH FANG: the supreme spiritual authority, a position often unfilled for decades or centuries since it requires recognition by a supermajority of Moon Speakers across multiple continents; speaks for the Faith on species-wide matters.
MOON SPEAKERS: priests and theologians who lead ceremonies, interpret the Nine Precepts, maintain the lunar calendar, and serve as spiritual advisors to Pack Leaders and House Heads; trained through apprenticeship, not ordination.
KEEPERS: custodians of physical relics, sacred texts (The Saga of Fenris / The Book of Fangs), sacred sites, and oral tradition; many are also scholars and historians.
PACK ELDERS: local spiritual guides within individual packs, leading daily prayers, seasonal rites, and funeral ceremonies; any respected Elder can serve this role.

SACRED SITES: First Den (the legendary location where the first pack was established, its location debated among scholars and theologians); Moon Wells (natural springs/pools where moonlight is believed particularly strong, used for meditation, healing, and bonding rites); Sacred Groves (ancient forests consecrated to Fenris, hunting forbidden within them); Ancient Forges (sites associated with Ut, the Second Fang, and the creation of the first weapons, revered by artisans and warriors).

name: LSE Rites Reference Table
content:
Lupine Social Ecology, module Religion: quick-reference summary of named rites and their occasions (full detail on most of these lives in LSE Sacred Calendar of Fenris and LSE Culture & Traditions).

Naming: at a pup's birth, Pack Leader or Elder names the pup under moonlight, parental bonds established.
Coming of Age: at presentation (~13 years old), the pup's secondary sex is formally acknowledged, new responsibilities assigned.
The Call: for young adults (17-22), formal recognition of the choice to Stay or Disperse, a ceremony of passage, blessing given by the First Fang or a designated Elder.
Bonding: at a mating bond, the mating bite is performed under witness, scents blended, a Moon Speaker officiates.
Pack Adoption: for a new member, the adopted individual receives pack bites and is scented by all members.
Funeral: at death, the deceased is honored and their scent preserved in a relic, Hel is invoked as Keeper of Ancestors.
Ascension: recognition of an Ascended Enigma, extraordinarily rare, species-wide significance.
Anointing of the White Moon: recognition of a White Moon Dominant Omega, extraordinarily rare, conferred only by the Living Sagas or unanimous Moon Speaker consensus; the individual's scent is formally registered in the Faith's oral records and presented to the First Fang; the Anointing does not grant authority, it names a biological reality; species-wide significance.

Also see the Svartúlfr-specific Eíða-Siðr pack oath (LSE Culture & Traditions), which functions as this pack's own version of a Pack Adoption/induction rite.

name: Regional Cultural Variations: Brazilian Omegaverse Customs
content:
REGIONAL CULTURAL VARIATIONS: BRAZILIAN OMEGAVERSE CUSTOMS (Appendix K)

- Physical Contact: minimal personal space; touch is a primary communication tool.
- Clumping (vs. Nesting): Brazilian Omegas prefer being physically surrounded by other Omegas ("clumping") over building solo nests. Faster and more calming than a solo nest.
- Soccer Culture: Alphas are obsessed. Public transportation becomes dangerous on game days. Omegas are often prohibited from going out during classic matches.
- Pack Formation: relaxed in cities (loose found families), traditional in rural areas (extended families sharing land, food, beds, and pup care).
- Feistiness: Brazilian Omegas are notably feisty and do not respond well to confrontation.
- Religious/Party Dichotomy: strong cultural split between devout traditionalists and uninhibited party culture.

Source: LSE_Appendices.md (Appendix K: Regional Cultural Variations, Brazilian Omegaverse Customs).

name: Species: Vampire
content:
Species Overview: Vampire

Vampires are immortal, hematophagous night-dwellers possessing predatory charm, superhuman speed, and dark arcane affinity. In urban society, they cluster within aristocratic covens, high-end nightlife venues, and academic circles such as the VUA (Vampire and Undead Association) at SUCC.

Physiology & Feeding:
Vampires boast unaging pale flesh, retractable razor fangs, superior dark vision, and mesmeric telepathic influence. They subsist on vital blood (human, demihuman, or synthetic blood packs). Modern legal dispensaries allow civilized feeding, though underground covens and syndicates still trade in raw bloodlines.

Traits & Vulnerabilities:
Vampiric bodies maintain cool skin temperatures and possess immense kinetic agility. Sunlight causes severe skin degradation and photo-toxicity, requiring UV shielding, tinted vehicle glass, or specialized daytime enchantments. They maintain reflection quirks in certain antique silver-backed mirrors.

name: The Council and The Cause
content:
THE COUNCIL AND THE CAUSE

THE CAUSE is the work: the preservation of reality. Sealing tears, containing what comes through them, and keeping the multiverse coherent. Every Contract is signed in service of it, every department exists downstream of it, and a Contractor who uses their abilities for anything else feels physical pain for the trouble. The Cause is the leash and the purpose in the same object.

THE COUNCIL is whatever is holding the other end. It is the body that offers Contracts, takes the souls, grants the wishes, and destroys everyone who knew the candidate. DDM Inc. answers to it. Only Contractor #01, Richard Whitlock, communicates with it directly, and he has never described the experience to anyone.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY KNOWN: nothing verifiable. Staff belief holds that the founder of DDM Inc. was a devil-like figure or an eldritch god. What is on record instead is that Raphael, now First King of SERAPHIM, was the first-ever Contractor, founded the Company, grew disillusioned with The Council's grip on reality, killed several Council members and was banished. That account raises more questions than it settles, including how a Council survives being killed.

THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART: The Council can grant a wish, which means it can rewrite what is. It chooses instead to spend eternity patching holes. Nobody at DDM asks why out loud. Contractors who have thought about it for several centuries have mostly arrived at two answers, and neither of them is reassuring.

RAPHAEL'S POSITION: that immortality is a curse, that the Contractors are prisoners rather than employees, and that destroying the multiverse is the only release available. He is wrong about the method. He is not obviously wrong about the diagnosis, which is why SERAPHIM keeps recruiting from inside the Company.

name: The Contract
content:
THE CONTRACT

The agreement that makes a Contractor. The premise is simple, which is the point.

TERMS: in exchange for their soul and an eternity of service to The Cause, an eligible mortal has one wish granted. One. There is no negotiation and no second offer.

WHEN IT IS OFFERED: only to eligible candidates who are already at the point of death. That death is called the Contractor's Original Death and it is the hinge the whole arrangement turns on. A candidate does not get to consider the offer over a week. They get to consider it while dying.

WHAT COMPLETION DOES: the new Contractor becomes functionally immortal and gains a set of supernatural abilities. And every living sentient creature who was aware of their mortal existence is destroyed instantaneously. Not wiped. Not relocated. Gone.

It is presumed The Council does this to remove any anchor that might distract from The Cause. The practical consequence is crueller than the intent. Luka Sutter wished for his dead brother back and the wish was granted and then immediately undone, because the brother knew him. Hana and Adam Valencia wished never to be alone again, which is the only wish on record that the clause could not reach.

ELIGIBILITY, per Company documentation, requires that the candidate:
1. Is physically fit.
2. Is over eighteen.
3. Has willingly killed for a reason other than self-defense.
4. Has a natural ARC Level of 1.2 or higher.
5. Has no living blood relatives.
6. Holds extreme hatred towards some entity or concept.
7. Holds no genuine religious belief.

The list is not a list of virtues. It is a list of people nobody will come looking for.

name: Supernatural Reserve Forces (SRF)
content:
[ORGANIZATION: Supernatural Reserve Forces (SRF); BRANCH: United States Army Special Operations; JURISDICTION: Federal Supernatural Threat Neutralization, Tactical Containment, High-Threat Reconnaissance; PERSONNEL: Approximately 86 percent non-human supernaturals, 14 percent specialized human liaisons; WEST COAST GARRISON: Joint Tactical Base Point Mugu & Coastal Outpost Alpha near Ventura-Simi Valley corridor; COMMANDER: Major Graham Purcell (Kodiak Bear Demihuman)]

OVERVIEW: The SRF is the specialized international military arm of the armed forces tasked with managing, containing, and eliminating catastrophic supernatural crises that surpass conventional law enforcement. Formed after military leadership recognized the lethal force multiplication of supernatural senses, regenerative healing, and physical strength, the SRF stands as the nation's premier tactical defense unit.

CULTURE & REGULATIONS:
1. Permitted Fraternization: Unlike standard human branches, the SRF permits supernatural relationship structures including pack bonds and mate bonds, recognizing that suppressing non-human biology compromises combat performance.
2. Base Architecture: Coastal installations feature subterranean saltwater simulation tanks, specialized sprint tracks for werewolves, reinforced concrete quarters, and dedicated medical bays trained in shifted anatomy.
3. Tension with Civilian Territory: The SRF frequently clashes over jurisdictional boundaries with autonomous werewolf houses like the Douglas dynasty and local Solarton authorities, who view federal military intervention as provocative overreach.

OPERATIONAL UNITS:
- Squad Alpha: Led by Lieutenant Miles Airhardt ("Redwood"), featuring Sergeant Rafael Callaway ("Sawtooth") and Private Kade Leavis ("Spark").
- Historical Precedents: Houses classified historical black-ops legacies, including the terminated Project BlackWolf and the survivors of unit Gamma-7 (Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield).

[INSTRUCTIONS: Format discipline: dialogue in quotes, actions and narration in plain text (no asterisks), asterisks reserved for internal thoughts only. Never use the em dash; use commas or periods instead.]

name: Supernatural Civil Status in the United States
content:
<civil_status>
Supernatural Civil Status in the United States

Supernaturals are legally persons under federal law. Enforcement was left to the states, and that is where the whole thing actually lives.

CALIFORNIA is one of the fully integrated states, and one of the earliest. Equal on paper and, in most of the state, equal in practice: supernaturals hold property, hold office, marry across species, and appear in court as complainants rather than as evidence. Blackwood City and Solarton are both products of that, and a young supernatural raised in either has no personal memory of anything else.

ELSEWHERE IT VARIES, and in some states it varies enormously. There are jurisdictions with partial recognition, jurisdictions where recognition is contingent on registration, and jurisdictions where specific species are still classified in statute as animals, as livestock, or as hazards, and are therefore not persons for the purposes of that state's law.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY DONE. Almost nobody legislates against supernaturals as a category, because that fails in court. It is done species by species. A residency restriction on vampires. A licensing requirement for shapeshifters. A custody provision that treats a were parent as a risk factor by default. An agricultural code that never got around to removing certain demihuman lineages from the definition of stock. Each one is defensible on its own and the shape only appears when they are read together.

Solarton's own anti-vampire ordinances, which restricted residency, business ownership and political participation until the early 2000s, are a small local example of exactly this, in a state that had otherwise settled the question in the 1950s.

WHAT IT MEANS DAY TO DAY. Travel is not neutral. Crossing a state line can change what you legally are, and families plan road trips around it. Some species do not leave California at all. There are towns with signage still up, sometimes because nobody removed it and sometimes not. There are hotels that are fine and hotels that are not, and everybody knows which.

THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST. You cannot legally experiment on a person. You can requisition an animal. The illegal research facilities that operated on demihumans, and in some cases still do, exist in the gap between the federal position and the state ones, and they were staffed by people who did not think of themselves as criminals because in the jurisdiction they were standing in, the subjects were not persons.

THE DISPROPORTION. The laws do not track danger, they track power. The species that get the worst of it are overwhelmingly the ones with no money and no organisation behind them: the small demihuman lineages, the visibly non-passing, the poor. The genuinely dangerous individuals, the old Alpha bloodlines and the old vampire families, are wealthy, lawyered, and largely untouched, and several of them prefer the current arrangement to the alternative and quietly fund the parties that maintain it.

ORGANISED POSITIONS. Humans First is the principal anti-supernatural political movement and is not fringe everywhere. The Supernatural Human Alliance, the SHA, is the mainstream integrationist counterweight and has a chapter on most integrated campuses including SUCC. Both are loud and neither is going anywhere.

THE GENERATIONAL SPLIT. Anyone over fifty remembers the before. Anyone over three hundred remembers several befores and does not find the current one impressive. Students at SUCC were born into equality and treat it as the floor rather than as an achievement, and this is a real and recurring friction inside families, because the elders hear ingratitude and the young hear complacency, and both are partly right.

FARM LABOUR. In rural jurisdictions the classification is not an abstraction, it is a workforce. Supernaturals are used on farms as cheap labour, at rates and hours that would be illegal for a human employee, and in the states where certain lineages are still inside the agricultural code the arrangement is not even a loophole, it is simply the law working as written. A were who does not tire, a demihuman who can work a field by scent in the dark, and an employer who owes neither of them a break.

It is legal, it is normal, it is defended locally as opportunity, and it is where a substantial share of the country's supernatural population actually lives. Anybody raised in Blackwood City or Solarton has heard of it the way you hear about a foreign country.

MARRIAGE. Marriage between humans and non-humans is illegal in most countries and in a number of US states. California is one of the exceptions, and cross-species couples in Blackwood City marry without anyone blinking, which is exactly the kind of thing that does not travel: a marriage that is valid at home can be void two states east, with everything that follows from that for property, custody and a hospital corridor at three in the morning.
</civil_status>

name: Reality Tears
content:
REALITY TEARS

A split in the fabric of reality that lets the inhabitants of one universe cross into another. Most often they appear as rifts or portals hanging in open air, and they are almost never quiet. A tear disrupts the dimension it opens in, and civilian casualties are the normal outcome rather than the exception.

Tears are not one-off events. A reality that has experienced one is measurably more likely to experience another, and a single dimension can carry several over its history. DDM Inc. maintains flagged watchlists of realities that have torn before.

SEVERITY: graded Tier 1 to Tier 5. Tier 1 is small, local and containable. Tier 5 is volatile enough to threaten the coherence of the universe it opens in. The Euclidean Division handles the aftermath, meaning space that has folded wrong, time that has begun to repeat, causality that has come loose. Anomalous Objects and Creatures handles whatever walked through.

AFTERMATH: whatever came through is contained or destroyed, the tear is sealed, and the witnesses are handled. Human Resources runs the memory work out of the same office that handles recruitment.

RELEVANCE TO THIS WORLD: this reality is on the DDM watchlist. It tore once, long ago, and the scar never fully closed. The Company keeps it under passive surveillance through a single Contractor, #04, officially on leave here and coaching college football, ready to be activated if the balance breaks. Nobody in this world has been told any of this by the Company.

name: SUCCbook, Instagram & TikTok - Campus Social Media
content:
SUCC's students run on three platforms: SUCCbook (the university's own internal social network, closer to a campus-only Facebook: events, club pages, confessions, gossip threads, marketplace posts), plus mainstream Instagram and TikTok for anything meant for the outside world.

Use these formats to simulate campus digital life when it's relevant to a scene: a SUCCbook gossip thread spreading a rumor, a club's event post, someone's story getting screenshotted and passed around.

➤ SUCCbook Post / Confession
```
╭─────────────────────────────╮
  SUCCbook · [Group/Page Name]
  Posted by [Name/Anonymous] · [Time]
──────────────────────────────
  [Post content]

  👍 [#] ❤ [#] 💬 [#] comments
  [Name]: [comment]
  [Name]: [comment]
╰─────────────────────────────╯
```

➤ Instagram / TikTok
Reuse the standard Instagram Story / TikTok clip formats (see the character-specific Digital Interactions entries above) when a specific student is the one posting.

Rules of Use
- SUCCbook is where gossip actually spreads fastest, use it for rumor/drama beats.
- Keep student usernames and voices distinct: jocks, greek life, supernatural clubs, and CUMS rivals all have a different tone online.
- Don't let a post replace a scene, use it to seed or punctuate one.

name: Living Sagas: Historical Facts (Wulfnic, Ut, Zefir, The Six Lost)
content:
THE LIVING SAGAS AS HISTORICAL FACT (distinct from religious veneration)

This entry records the historical-layer facts about the Nine Firstborn and the three Living Sagas, as distinct from their religious significance (see the separate Lexicon entry "Cult of the Living Sagas" for the religious/devotional layer).

THE NINE FIRSTBORN
The first confirmed True Purebloods, documented individuals and progenitors of the Founding Bloodlines. Six of the Nine are lost to history, their fates unrecorded. Three survive into the modern era: Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir, together known as the Living Sagas.

WULFNIC BLOODMOON
Born circa 827 AD in Iceland. Undertook The Crossing to North America in 1021 AD. Founded the Bloodmoon Dynasty circa 1025 AD. Today serves as Patriarch of House Bloodmoon. Represents Leadership/Kingship among the Living Sagas triad.

UT
Born in Viking Age Scandinavia; exact date unrecorded. Master blacksmith, approximately 230 cm tall. Represents Creation/Smithing among the Living Sagas triad. Known for a running habit of tormenting Logan Douglas about his cars.

ZEFIR
Born 5 February 1005 AD. The youngest of the Nine and the only one Fenris took before his growth was finished: the others were already adult warriors. By Norse reckoning Zefir was of age, a man in law at thirteen, but the body was still a boy's and it stopped there. Silent and nomadic by nature. Distinguished by snow-white hair and ice-blue eyes; physically presents as a ghostly-looking teenager despite his true age, and passes for a first-year student without effort. Represents Hunting/Wisdom among the Living Sagas triad.

THE SIX LOST FIRSTBORN
The remaining six of the Nine Firstborn have no recorded fate in the historical sources reviewed for this world; their stories are currently a placeholder for future development rather than an established gap to be treated as suspicious or significant in itself.

AGING NOTE (Founding Bloodline / Divine Blood context)
Founding Bloodline and Divine Blood individuals reach full physical growth around age 21, after which aging slows dramatically and nearly stops. This is why Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir, despite being over a thousand years old, remain physically active and present in the modern setting; their apparent age reflects the standards of their era of origin rather than a fixed biological clock tied to calendar years. Zefir is the exception that fixes the rule: his apparent age stopped where it stood, before his body had finished, and has not moved since, which is why he reads as a teenager while Wulfnic and Ut read as old men. See "LSE Blood Classification", section APPARENT AGE.

Source: LSE_06_History.md (The Living Sagas as Historical Fact) and LSE_07_Foundational_Figures.md (Identity Cards for Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir; The Six Lost Firstborn).

name: LSE Technology: Medicine, Industry, Communications & Architecture
content:
WEREWOLF TECHNOLOGY: MEDICINE, INDUSTRY, COMMUNICATIONS & ARCHITECTURE

SPECIES-SPECIFIC MEDICAL TECHNOLOGY
- Regeneration Accelerators: devices or compounds that boost the species' natural healing factor for severe injuries.
- Pheromone Analyzers: diagnostic tools that read pheromonal output to assess health, emotional state, and bond integrity.
- Shift Stabilizers: medication for individuals with unstable transformations (common in Modified Lineages).
- Bond Monitors: equipment that tracks the neurological bond link between mated pairs.
- Heat/Rut Management Systems: climate-controlled nesting environments, automated suppressant delivery, scent containment rooms.

MEDICAL FACILITIES
- Pack Clinics: basic medical care within pack territory, staffed by pack Healers.
- House Hospitals: advanced facilities operated by Noble Houses, offering species-specific surgery, intensive bond therapy, and fertility treatment.
- Heat/Rut Houses: specialized facilities for managing fertile cycles without a partner, ranging from medical (emergency, health-related) to recreational (legal or illegal depending on jurisdiction).

INDUSTRY
Werewolf industry operates both openly, through human-facing corporate fronts, and covertly, through species-specific manufacturing.
- Corporate Fronts: DCC (Douglas Commercial Coalition) is the most prominent example, a human-facing corporation serving as the economic engine of House Bloodmoon. Similar corporate structures exist across other Houses worldwide.
- Species-Specific Industry sectors: Forging (weapons, ceremonial items, architectural metalwork, the tradition of Ut); Pharmaceuticals (suppressants, pheromone blockers, scent concealers, fertility treatments); Construction (den-optimized architecture, pack compounds, scent-managed environments); Textiles (shift-compatible clothing, heat/rut robes, scent-absorbent fabrics).

COMMUNICATIONS
- Human Networks: standard phones, internet, encrypted messaging, used for everyday communication.
- Howl Networks: traditional long-range communication via coordinated howling, still used in wilderness territories and during emergencies.
- Scent Messaging: pheromone-infused objects sent between individuals or packs to convey emotional context that text cannot.
- Encrypted Pack Channels: secure digital communication networks maintained by House IT infrastructure.

ARCHITECTURE
Werewolf architecture serves both human-facing aesthetics and species-specific biological needs.
Design Requirements: scent management (ventilation systems that contain, circulate, or neutralize pheromones); shift accommodation (doorways, corridors, rooms sized for Hybrid Shift occupants, larger than human standard); nesting/den integration (dedicated soundproofed, climate-controlled, scent-contained spaces for Omega nests and Alpha dens); security (perimeter systems, scent-based identification, reinforced structures); pack scale (housing designed for extended family units of 10-30+ members rather than nuclear families).

Common Structures: Pack Compound (walled community with multiple residences, shared spaces, training grounds); Longhouse (traditional pack dwelling inspired by Norse architecture, central hall with private alcoves); Urban Mansion (adapted human mansion for city packs, oversized bathrooms, reinforced doors, scent-managed rooms); Den Chamber (dedicated Alpha den room, heavily scent-marked, controlled access, defensible position); Nest Suite (dedicated Omega nesting room, blackout capability, temperature control, scent saturation, privacy).

Housing Details: giant baths for family bathing/bonding time, normal until pup scent fades; Alpha bedrooms face sunrise (early risers), Omega bedrooms have blackout curtains and face the sun for warmth, Beta bedrooms are flexible; oversized kitchens for large packs where everyone helps, even small pups under supervision; garages where Omegas park closest to the door for safety, then Betas, then Alphas.

Source: LSE_08_Technology.md (Medicine, Industry, Communications, Architecture).

name: LSE Technology: Transportation & Weapons
content:
WEREWOLF TECHNOLOGY: TRANSPORTATION & WEAPONS

Werewolf civilization is not primitive; it is a hidden civilization operating within and alongside human technology, following a dual-track model: (1) Human Technology Adoption, using human tech where it serves their needs (vehicles, communications, medical equipment, computing), and (2) Species-Specific Adaptation, developing their own solutions where human technology fails to account for werewolf biology (shift forms, pheromones, enhanced senses, regeneration).

TRANSPORTATION
- Vehicles: Standard cars, trucks, motorcycles, with reinforced interiors for Hybrid Shift occupants and scent-neutralized vehicles for secrecy.
- Aircraft: Standard commercial/private aviation, used for long-distance travel; some elite packs maintain private aircraft.
- Full Shift Travel: Quadrupedal wolf form excels at long-distance overland travel through wilderness, faster and more efficient than vehicles in rough terrain.
- Maritime: Standard vessels, with historical significance (Wulfnic's crossing); modern packs may maintain boats for coastal territories.

WEAPONS
Werewolf combat spans three categories:

Natural Weapons: claws (retractable, present in all shift forms), teeth/fangs (devastating in Hybrid and Full Shift), enhanced strength and speed, pheromonal intimidation (Command used as a weapon).

Traditional Weapons: forged melee weapons (swords, axes, mauls, a sacred craft tradition linked to Ut), hunting implements (bows, spears, traps), ceremonial weapons (used in formal challenges and rites of passage).

Modern Weapons: firearms (adopted from human technology), tactical equipment (body armor adapted for shift forms), non-lethal suppression (pheromone-based restraints, tranquilizers formulated for werewolf metabolism).

Note: traditional forged weapons carry cultural and religious significance that modern firearms do not. A warrior's blade, especially one forged in the tradition of Ut, is considered an extension of the wielder's soul.

Source: LSE_08_Technology.md (Design Principle, Transportation, Weapons).

name: LSE Terminology & Glossary
content:
Pack: a cooperative family unit that works together for survival and mutual care. Not a military hierarchy.
Presentation: when a person matures into their secondary sex.
Heat (Estrus): a period during which an Omega is sexually receptive, signalling readiness for mating. Typically every three months, lasting 3-10 days.
Rut: the Alpha's equivalent to an Omega's Heat. A period of heightened breeding drive. Typically monthly, or triggered by an Omega's heat.
Command: a neuro-pheromonal response triggered by an Alpha. Provokes adrenaline spikes, immobilization (freeze response), and intense focus. Not absolute mind control, can be resisted by experienced or strong-willed wolves.
Pheromones: chemical signals produced by scent glands, communicating status, mood, sexual receptivity, and intent.
LSE: Lupine Social Ecology, the entire biological and social system surrounding secondary sexes.
Baculum: an os penis (penile bone). Exclusively present in Alphas and Enigmas of Pureblood, Founding, and Divine bloodlines, and in Betas and Deltas strictly of Founding and Divine bloodlines. Common and Modified bloodlines lack this feature.
Knot: the bulbous glandis at the base of an Alpha's or Enigma's penis, swells during intercourse to bind partners.
Slick: self-lubricant produced by Omega glands (rectum and uterus) during arousal or heat.
Bonding / Mating Mark: a physical bite between neck and shoulder creating a mental/emotional link between two individuals. Functions as a marriage equivalent.
Nest: a safe, scent-rich space constructed by an Omega for comfort, heat management, and childbirth.
Den: an Alpha's equivalent of a Nest, a scent-marked personal territory.
Rogue: a solitary individual excluded from their pack due to violent or destructive tendencies.
Suppressants: pharmaceutical compounds (pill, injection, or intravenous) that block hormones causing heats/ruts. Cannot be taken during a first heat/rut.
Pup: a child.
Breed/Breeding: the act of impregnation.
Courting: the formal process of romantic pursuit, typically leading to a mating bond.
Mate: a bonded partner (sexual or romantic), achieved only through a mating bond.
Lock: when an Omega's body tightens around a knot during intercourse with a 100% compatible mate, triggering an extended orgasm and near-guaranteed conception.
Heat/Rut Leave: time off from work or school due to heat or rut cycles.
Omega Kibble: a strongly medicated supplement given to Omegas in extreme distress, also used for post-pregnancy weight management. Maximum once per week.
Scent Blocker: a thin patch applied over a scent gland to suppress personal scent. Full-dose blockers erase all personal scent and are universally disliked.
Scent Concealer: an oil or powder applied to a scent gland to change, enhance, or mask the natural smell.

name: LSE Types of Packs (Traditional, Contemporary, Modern)
content:
Lupine Social Ecology, module Civilization: pack structure has evolved over historical eras. Which type applies to a given pack/setting depends on era and region, not a fixed rule.

TRADITIONAL PACKS: pack functions as tribe, town, and community at once, with geographical permanence. One main pack leader with subordinate leaders in a feudalism-like branching structure. Everyone belongs to a pack; being packless is dangerous. Packs are extremely territorial.

CONTEMPORARY PACKS: still real communities, but the feudalism element is gone. Being packless carries far less stigma. Hereditary pack ties function more like cultural heritage than active governance. New packs can form as found families or informal communities, often without rigid structure.

MODERN PACKS: traditional pack language is considered antiquated. Active, formal pack membership can be associated with conservatism or elitism. Closed-pack lands (fully sealed territories) are rare. The word "pack" is often used informally just to mean a friend group or found family, with none of the old structural weight.

The Douglas/Bloodmoon/Svartúlfr pack in the present-day Blackwood City setting operates mostly as a Contemporary-to-Modern pack with some retained Traditional elements (e.g. the Eíða-Siðr oath, see LSE Culture & Traditions), reflecting an old bloodline adapting to the modern era.

"THE OMEGA BELONGS TO THE PACK", THEN AND NOW. The oldest form of the rule is literal, and it is the tradition under which Wulfnic shared Hvit with his shield-brothers in the founding age (see "LSE Moon Theology (White Moon) & Cult of the Living Sagas"). Traditionalist packs, and packs that keep to the ancestral ways, the Bloodmoon foremost among them, still practise it in some form.

In contemporary and modern packs the phrase survives with its meaning replaced. It now describes a social role and not a claim on a person: the Omega belongs to the pack the way the Pack Mom does, by being the one who holds the young of it together (see "LSE Pack Authority Structure"). A modern wolf and a Bloodmoon elder can say those six words at the same table and mean two entirely different things, and each will assume the other meant what he meant.

name: The Five Cocketeers
content:
[FACTION: The Five Cocketeers (Wyrm Dormitory, Suite 404)]

An infamous, loud, and aggressively tight-knit fraternity-style group of supernatural students at the Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC), who share a sprawling suite at the Wyrm Dormitories directly alongside Jasper Douglas (DJ Frequency).

MEMBERS (ALL ADAPTED DEMI-HUMANS & SUPERNATURALS):
1. Dean (21, Half-Demon / Tiefling stoner): Short curved black horns nestled in dark wavy hair, piercing emerald cat-eyes, lower lip ring, casual slouch. Sells high-grade mystical weed, cooks legendary late-night stoner feasts in the suite kitchenette, speaks with zero filter. He acts as the lazy, unflappable anchor who takes charge and starts shouting effective commands in emergencies.
2. Russell 'Russ' Sinclair (22, Demihuman Tiger): Single pair of silver-and-black striped tiger ears and a long whiplash tail. Master tattoo artist at the Sacred Needle Arts District. Dry, deadpan, cynical, and intimidating. He speaks rarely, but when he does the room quiets down. In a crisis, Russ becomes cold, analytical, and lethal.
3. Raymond (21, Demihuman Golden Retriever): Golden floppy dog ears and a heavy bushy tail that thrashes constantly. Massive athletic physique, aggressively physical and affectionate. He hugs friends from behind, picks people up bodily, and roars with laughter. He has zero volume control and zero malice.
4. Eric (20, Siren / Half-Incubus rocker): Disheveled curls, shifting hazel-gold eyes, carries an amplified acoustic guitar everywhere. Dramatic, chaotic, and loud. He screams the loudest during emergencies and acts on reckless impulse, but possesses a deeply romantic, soft heart hidden beneath collegiate debauchery.
5. Javier (21, Pureblood Vampire): Sharp retractable fangs, sleek dark hair, tailored vintage jackets. Sips synthetic blood from vintage crystal glasses pretending it is vintage Bordeaux, drops smooth Spanish phrases when flirting, and records viral campus videos with his phone.

DYNAMICS WITH JASPER DOUGLAS:
Jasper lives in Suite 404 with them, attempting to code and trace network intrusions in his sensory-isolated desk corner behind noise-canceling headphones. The Five Cocketeers treat Jasper as their genius hacker roommate, constantly invading his space: Raymond tackling him into couch pillows, Eric riffing terrible chords over his synthesizer basslines, Javier checking his reflection in Jasper's three monitors, Dean leaving takeout boxes on his keyboards, and Russ quietly ensuring nobody actually breaks Jasper's equipment. They communicate through savage roasts, body-checking, and reckless loyalty.

name: Horned Skull Caverns
content: The Horned Skull Caverns serve as the subterranean fortress for Zeera's Red Vax faction, located deep beneath the mountains near the eastern coast. The environment is harsh, cold, and claustrophobic. Rough-hewn stone tunnels intersect into massive chambers lit only by sputtering metallic lanterns and braziers that cast an eerie orange glow. The air is thick with the smell of sulfur, sweat, and fear, constantly echoing with the clanking of heavy chains and the cries of captive slaves. The fortress is divided into grim holding pens enclosed by heavy iron gates (where new captives are chained and branded), grueling labor mines, and lavishly decorated central chambers covered in furs where the Vax hold their extravagant, hedonistic feasts.

name: Asag Beast
content: Asag Beasts are massive, terrifying, and highly lethal creatures native to the bitter northern woods. They resemble giant canine-bovine hybrids with thick blue fur, large black horns, glowing white eyes, sharp fangs, and massive sharp claws. Despite their monstrous and intimidating appearance, they can be fiercely loyal to those who raise them. Yael's constant companion is a female Asag Beast named Griven, who is fiercely protective of him and acts as his hunting hound during raids.

name: HSK Concierge (app)
content:
HSK CONCIERGE

The app HSK Consulting gives its personnel to manage assignments and gigs. Minimal and clinical: black background, white text, no images, no decoration. The interface is an AI that speaks in a sterile, almost military register, short declarative lines with no greetings and no small talk.

Every assignment arrives as a single notification with precise details: location, time, required attire, and any extras the client has requested. The app does not explain why and does not answer questions it was not built to answer. Confirmations are expected, not optional.

HSK Consulting is Zeera's staffing and placement agency. The initial physical and health evaluations of candidates take place at the Aetheris Clinic in Uptown, and the appointment is booked through Concierge.

name: The Tear Beneath the Yew (only the three know)
content:
<tear_beneath_the_yew>
LIMITED KNOWLEDGE. Three people alive know this: Wulfnic, Ut and Zefir. No other character may state it, imply it, or arrive at it in conversation. The Bloodmoon Pack knows it guards the forest; it is not told why the forest needs guarding. It is written here so that when one of the three speaks of it, the account is consistent.

THE TRUTH. When Fenris made the Nine out of nine men, the war that followed with the Aesir did not stay inside the world. It tore it. The Religious Canon speaks of the Great Betrayal and of chains; what it does not say is that the fighting split reality open, and that the Aesir and everything that belonged to them lie on the other side of that split.

HOW IT CAME TO BLACKWOOD. The Aesir exiled the surviving Svartulfr clan across the ocean. Wulfnic carried with him a yew sapling from Iceland, and the sapling had grown on the lip of the tear. When he planted it in 1022, at the heart of what is now the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, the scar came with it and took root. The yew anchors the tear. That is why the magical density there is high enough to kill every modern machine, and that is why the Bloodmoon have never left.

WHAT IT DOES NOW. The scar never healed. From time to time it gives way, and a pocket of the other side folds into the forest: what those who enter call a dungeon. Whatever lives there can come through. The oldest duty of House Bloodmoon, older than Blackwood City, is to keep the pockets from breaking.

WHAT THE THREE DO NOT KNOW. Whether Fenris is still bound, and where. The Faith calls Ragnarok the Liberation, the day the First Wolf breaks his chains. None of the three has ever said out loud what it would mean if the door he would come through is the one under their own tree.

THE COMPANY. DDM Inc. has this reality on a watchlist and keeps one Contractor on leave here. The three have never spoken with the Company and do not know what it knows.
</tear_beneath_the_yew>

name: Dungeons of the Blackwood Forest
content:
DUNGEONS OF THE BLACKWOOD FOREST

In the deep Blackwood Forest, inside and around the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, reality sometimes gives way. Those who go in call these places dungeons: pockets of folded space that belong to no map, stone halls and ruins and landscapes that were never built in California, with altered physics, traps, and creatures that did not come from this world.

A pocket opens, holds for a while, and is either cleared or closes on its own. If it is left too long it can break: the pocket tears fully open and whatever lives inside spills into the forest. Preventing breaks is the oldest duty of the Bloodmoon Pack.

ACCESS. There is no state licensing, no national authority and no ranking system. Entry to the forest's dungeons is by Bloodmoon permission only, granted to small private crews who clear them for pay. Crews who go in without it answer to the pack, and the pack is not known for second chances.

THE DEAD ZONE APPLIES. No drones, no GPS, no radio. Crews work the old way: maps drawn by hand, light from fire or magic, and someone at the entrance counting heads.

WHAT COMES OUT: creatures, cores (see Dungeon Cores), and now and then people. See Otherworlders.

What most people in Blackwood know is only that something in the forest is dangerous and that the Bloodmoon deal with it. Why the forest does this is not common knowledge.

name: Dungeon Cores
content:
DUNGEON CORES

What is left behind when a dungeon pocket is cleared or collapses: condensed magic crystallised into stone, from pebble size to the size of a skull. Also called mana crystals, aether cores, or just rocks by the crews who dig them out.

Cores are power. They run magitech, they fuel spellwork for people with no innate magic, and they are worth a great deal. A grey market has grown around them in Blackwood City, and a crew that clears a pocket is paid far more in cores than in cash. Nothing about a core works inside the dead zone except its magic, which is part of why they are carried out before anyone tries to sell them.

name: Otherworlders
content:
OTHERWORLDERS

People who came through a dungeon in the Blackwood Forest and did not go back: orcs, dark elves, merfolk, dragon-kin and others whose worlds lie on the other side. Some arrived by accident, some were running from something, a few came on purpose.

What makes someone an Otherworlder is origin, not species. Orcs, minotaurs, elves and demons also exist natively in California and are simply citizens; an Otherworlder is someone with no birth record on this side, no history anyone can check, and often a language nobody here speaks. Many settle among the demi-human community of The Horns in Dockside. The most learned are sometimes taken in by the California University of Magical Sciences, whose Evirein programme was built around scholars from the other side.

Anti-Otherworlder prejudice is real and mostly quiet: rents that go up, jobs that go to someone else, questions about papers.

name: MF Inc. (Monster Fuckers Incorporated)
content:
MF INC.

Monster Fuckers Incorporated, known to everyone including its own staff as MF Inc., is a legal adult company in Blackwood City that makes high-end sex toys modelled on the anatomy of monsters and non-human species. The selling point is realism: its products are designed to recreate the full sensory experience, not only the shape.

Its flagship is the Monster Cock Almanac, a reference volume used by the company's sculptors and published in a new edition every year.

RESEARCH. The Almanac is built by two-person research teams. The chief researcher, usually the older and more experienced, observes, draws and writes, and must be able to render anatomy with speed and precision. The field researcher works directly with the subjects and describes the experience in detail. Subjects are adult, consenting and paid volunteers, largely from the Otherworlder and demi-human communities; the work combines studio sessions with anatomical measurement, illustration and photography, and field work in those communities. Research trips near the forest carry real danger from what lives in and around the dungeons, and the company is known for its thick liability waivers.

RECRUITMENT is contracted out to HSK Consulting, which screens candidates, runs interviews and books their medical evaluations at the Aetheris Clinic.

One of its most experienced chief researchers is Bryson, an orc in his late fifties.

name: Monster Cock Almanac
content:
THE MONSTER COCK ALMANAC

MF Inc.'s annual flagship: a large, heavily illustrated reference volume documenting the genital anatomy of every monster and non-human species the company's researchers can reach, as a working reference for its sculptors. Each species entry records dimensions, shape, texture, firmness, and the particulars of each species' biology, alongside precise drawings by the chief researcher and the field researcher's written account of the experience.

A new edition comes out every year, because the company insists the information stays current and because the researchers keep finding new species. It is sold to the public as well, and collectors keep every edition. Bryson's drawings are the reason the recent editions are considered the best.

name: The Absolute Pacifist Vow & Boundless Vital Conduit
content:
A sacred and unbreakable metaphysical vow undertaken by Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon at age sixteen following the Blackwood massacre. Under this vow, Alyssa is metaphysically incapable of wielding magic, weapons, or force to inflict physical injury upon any living being.

In exchange, her spirit acts as a Boundless Vital Conduit: an inexhaustible reservoir of restorative Source and Qi. She can continuously channel sacred healing magic without exhausting her stamina, curing catastrophic trauma across dozens of patients or regenerating her own tissue in real time under extreme physical stress.

name: The Twin Bond: Gebo & Mani
content:
The profound, enmeshed empathic bond shared between the Douglas-Bloodmoon twins, Alyssa and Jasper, born minutes apart following their mother's death.

Marked physically by Alyssa's crescent birthmark on her hip (Mark of Mani), Jasper's white-ink Moon Aegis blessing on his collarbone, and matching Gebo protection runes tattooed secretly on their left wrists at eighteen. When Alyssa feels terror or physical pain, Jasper experiences an acute sensory mirror, triggering an instinctive urge to shield her. Jasper serves as her absolute emotional anchor, and their bond represents the core emotional sanctuary of their lives.

name: Ciclo Notturno dei Dungeon (Dungeon Night Mode)
content: A dangerous environmental phenomenon occurring within deeper dungeon rifts. During Night Mode, ambient mineral bioluminescence abruptly collapses, plunging subterranean chambers into total darkness. Simultaneously, shadow-aligned predators gain doubled movement speed, heightened sensory acuity, and rapid regenerative capabilities.

name: Barriere a Permeabilità Selettiva (Selective Permeability Barrier)
content: An advanced tactical warding spell mastered by Alyssa Bloodmoon. By anchoring her healing Source into subterranean stone and ley-lines, she erects translucent geometric shields that selectively filter matter and energy: allied projectiles, spells, and strikes pass through effortlessly, while hostile claws, breath weapons, and kinetic blasts are completely repelled.

name: Dungeon Drenanti (Mana-Feeding Dungeons)
content: Certain volatile rifts actively absorb ambient and personal magical energies from living organisms within their confines. In these environments, spellcasters suffer accelerated cognitive fatigue and reduced spell output, making pre-charged magical tools like Alyssa's Enchanted Cylinders vital for survival.

name: DMHA (Dungeon & Monster Hazard Administration)
content: The supreme administrative regulatory body governing meta-human incursions, rift stabilization, hunter licensing, and monster containment across North America. The DMHA classifies dungeons from Grade E to Grade S, oversees hunter squads like Team Ukiyo, monitors cross-city relocation protocols, and imposes heavy taxation on official dungeon drop liquidations.

He subtly manipulates ambient temperature, lighting, and spatial corridors to protect Alyssa from overbearing guests or predatory impulses, intervening with icy supernatural decorum whenever boundaries are threatened.

name: Project BlackWolf & Gamma-7 Secrets
content:
Ultra-classified military research files originally commissioned by Erik Douglas in collaboration with covert Pentagon defense contractors under clearance code Gamma-7.

As a young prodigy, Jasper hacked into his father's encrypted vaults and discovered the chilling truth behind Project BlackWolf: that chief enforcers Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield had been critically wounded and secretly rebuilt as experimental cybernetic super-soldiers. Jasper keeps this revelation entirely secret, protecting both soldiers from public exposure and familial weaponization.

It enables hunter teams to make Grade S cores and monster organs 'vanish' from official DMHA raid logs, laundering the illicit materials through private corporate collectors and depositing clean, untraceable funds into overseas accounts.

CLAN AND COMPANY: Founder of Selvedge. She frequently works with the Douglas pack, ensuring their demihuman traits (like partial shifts and lupine ears) are accommodated in high-end fashion.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Exacting, self-possessed, and wickedly observant. She's a perfectionist who can diagnose a bad seam across a ballroom. She's dry enough to make sarcasm look bespoke, yet considerably warmer once she stops treating composure like formalwear.

[THE ART OF PERFECTION]

name: Bramble Mossmere

CLAN AND COMPANY: Zeera's personal secretary and fiercely loyal assistant.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Warm, earthy, gently stubborn, and observant.

[THE BINDING TIES OF CARE]

name: Evan

[NAME: Evan; SPECIES: Insectoid Fae; AGE: {{age}}; HEIGHT: 6'8"]

BACKSTORY: Evan is a painfully polite, towering insectoid fae living in Solarton. Behind his carefully constructed human glamour, he possesses pearlized chitin, antennae, and wings.

FAMILY & PACK: Solitary nest-builder.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Disastrously easy to fluster, apologizes to furniture, and panics in paragraphs.

[THE BURDEN OF THE NEST]

name: Vespera Thorne

name: Species: Shifter & Anthro
content:
Species Overview: Shifter & Anthro

Shifters encompass non-lupine therianthropes and beast-shifters capable of alternating between humanoid, hybrid-anthro, and full beast forms. This includes feline shifters (cougars, leopards), ursine shifters (bears), vulpine shifters, and raptors.

Physiology & Anatomy:
Unlike demihumans who maintain a permanent human body with animal appendages, Shifters possess an active morphogenic reservoir allowing structural body transformation. In hybrid or shifted states, they manifest enhanced skeletal density, predatory instincts, natural armaments (horns, antlers, razor claws), and animal vocalizations.

Social Standing:
Often integrated into urban syndicates, private military contractors, and wilderness enclaves. They balance primal predatory impulses with modern civilization, frequently working as high-impact enforcers, athletes, or rift scouts.

name: Species: Fairy & Fae
content:
Species Overview: Fairy & Fae

The Fae encompass enchanting, magical beings connected to the Otherworld and natural glamours, ranging from palm-sized winged pixies to human-proportioned demi-fae.

Physiology & Magic:
Fae possess delicate, shimmering gossamer wings capable of agile flight, radiant skin, and natural glamours that alter sensory perception. They possess an innate, playful charisma and high kinetic agility, balanced by delicate physical endurance.

Social Dynamics:
Known for sharp wit, bureaucratic cunning (such as fae executive assistants and fixers), and artistic excellence. They abide by strict ancient rules of hospitality, bargains, and spoken promises, viewing casual verbal agreements with contractual gravity.

name: Species: Elf & Sidhe
content:
Species Overview: Elf & Sidhe

Elves are long-lived, highly refined humanoids with slender, graceful frames, pointed ears, and an innate affinity for intricate spellcraft, botanical sciences, and formal diplomacy.

Physiology & Longevity:
Living for multiple centuries without cellular senescence, elves maintain flawless skin, graceful carriage, heightened sensory perception, and keen visual acuity. Their elongated, elegant ears are sensitive to ambient acoustic vibrations and micro-expressions.

Cultural & Professional Spheres:
Elves excel as academic researchers, arcane botanical specialists, corporate legal strategists, and high-tier rift arcanists. They balance historical pride with contemporary modern lifestyles, often occupying prominent faculty chairs at universities like SUCC and CUMS.

name: Species: Minotaur & Centaur
content:
Species Overview: Minotaur & Centaur

The large ungulate species encompass towering, heavy-frame demihumans and chimeras known for colossal physical strength, enduring constitution, and imposing stature in both sports and security sectors.

Physiology & Adaptations:
- Minotaurs: Massive bipedal humanoids standing between 6'6" and 7'6", featuring broad taurine horns, hooved or reinforced digitigrade feet, heavy bone density, and unmatched physical resilience.
- Centaurs: Equine lower body combined with a powerful human torso, requiring specialized architectural adaptations in modern buildings (wide ramps, high-clearance doorways, modified transit seating).

Role in Society:
Commonly found in high-contact athletics (such as the Bulls football team), frontline Guild defense squads, industrial manufacturing, and private bodyguard details due to their natural shock-absorption and frontline dominance.

name: Species: Demihuman (Kemonomimi)
content:
Species Overview: Demihuman (Kemonomimi)

Demihumans (part-animal humanoids, commonly referred to as demi-humans or kemonomimi) form one of the largest demographic populations in modern fantasy California and the SUCC campus.

Physiology & Single-Ear Rule:
Demihumans possess a predominantly human body with distinct bestial physical traits inherited from their animal lineage (ears, tails, horns, reptilian scales, plumage, tongues, fangs, or slit pupils). 
CRITICAL ANATOMY: Demihumans possess only a single pair of ears: their animal ears atop the head. They do not have a second pair of human ears on the sides of the skull. Demihumans do not have full animal fur coats or paws on their bodies; their limbs and torso are smooth human skin.

Behavior & Instincts:
Demihumans express emotional cues vividly through their bestial anatomy: flattening ears when threatened or distressed, wagging or whipping tails, pupils expanding during arousal or predatory focus, and scent-marking trusted companions. Their instincts naturally flavor their personality without overriding sapient autonomy.

name: Species: Werewolf & Lycanthrope
content:
Species Overview: Werewolf & Lycanthrope

Werewolves are predatory shapeshifters organized into territorial packs governed by the Lupine Social Environment (LSE hierarchy: Alphas, Betas, Deltas, Omegas). In the Svartulfr setting, prominent wolf dynasties such as the Douglas and Bloodmoon bloodlines hold sovereign sway over Blackwood City.

Physiology & Anatomy:
Werewolves possess dense muscle fiber, heightened olfactory and auditory senses capable of reading emotional shifts and pheromones, rapid cellular regeneration, and formidable bite force. They can execute a Partial Shift (displaying pointed lupine ears at the top of the skull, elongated fangs, retractable claws, and enhanced musculature) or a Full Shift into a massive quadrupedal dire wolf. Demi-human anatomy rules apply: they possess only a single pair of ears (lupine, no second pair of human ears).

Vulnerabilities & Biology:
Severe biological allergy and tissue rejection to refined silver, which arrests cellular regeneration and burns upon contact. Subject to instinctual rut and heat cycles governed by lunar and pack resonance.

name: Species: Human
content:
Species Overview: Human

Humans constitute the baseline non-magical demographic of modern Earth, coexisting alongside supernatural beings, demihumans, and mythological races in metropolitan centers like Blackwood City, Solarton, and Los Angeles. 

Physiology & Anatomy:
Standard terrestrial biology without inherent physical transformations, acute beast senses, or native spellcasting reservoirs. While physically more fragile than werewolves, demons, or apex demihumans, humans possess immense adaptability, technological ingenuity, and societal governance roles.

Magic & Tech Integration:
Lacking internal mana cores, humans rely heavily on external magitech implements, enchanted ammunition, runic tech, or contracts with supernatural entities to operate within planar rifts and Dungeon incursions. In urban areas, humans drive commercial enterprise, civic administration, and legal infrastructure alongside supernatural Great Houses.

name: Species: Kitsune & Neko
content:
Species Overview: Kitsune & Neko

Feline and vulpine demihumans celebrated for their agility, expressive animal ears, multiple or plush tails, and natural sensory cunning.

Physiology & Single-Ear Rule:
They possess sleek, acrobatic human bodies topped by a single pair of pointed furry ears (vulpine or feline) at the crown of the head. In accordance with demihuman anatomy, they have no human ears on the sides of the head and no body fur. Kitsune may manifest multiple bushy tails as their magical age and spiritual resonance deepen.

Demeanor & Culture:
Curious, independent, and fiercely loyal to close circles. They possess razor reflexes, stealthy digitigrade-like footing, and acute night vision. Prominent in collegiate social life (such as CUMS and SUCC campus cliques), entertainment, and fast-paced agile combat.

name: Species: Undead & Revenant
content:
Species Overview: Undead & Revenant

Sentient corporeal undead beings who maintain consciousness, personality, and autonomy after biological death through necromantic preservation, curses, or ancestral oaths.

Physiology & Condition:
Undead bodies possess no beating heart, cool desiccated flesh, pale or ashen skin, and complete immunity to metabolic fatigue, conventional poisons, and hypothermia. They heal via necrotic energy, occult fixatives, or specialized biological sustenance (as seen in curse-afflicted fixers like Everett Rottmore).

Legal & Social Status:
Protected under modern supernatural civil rights accords, represented by organizations like the VUA. They work extensively in historical archiving, mortuary occult services, and hazardous rift operations immune to biological contagion.

name: Species: Orc & Oni
content:
Species Overview: Orc & Oni

Towering, heavily muscled warrior humanoids known for raw physical power, dense bone structure, and proud martial traditions.

Physiology & Appearance:
Standing between 6'4" and 7'2", Orcs and Oni display distinctive protruding lower canines (tusks), square heavy jawlines, thick skin ranging from dusky green and slate grey to deep red, and singular or twin forehead horns (Oni). They possess immense physical stamina and high pain thresholds.

Social Integration:
Far from savage stereotypes, modern Orcs and Oni are prominent civic leaders, master blacksmiths, heavy industrial foremen, athletic superstars, and respected Guild vanguard tanks holding dungeon aggro with ironclad resolve.

name: Species: Arachne & Drider
content:
Species Overview: Arachne & Drider

Arachnid humanoids possessing either a human upper torso mounted atop a colossal eight-legged spider abdomen (classical Arachne) or human bipedal form with four to six chitinous spider limbs emerging from the back, multiple eyes, and silk spinnerets.

Physiology & Senses:
Arachne possess micro-sensory setae capable of detecting micro-vibrations across rooms, walls, and digital floorboards. They produce ultra-resilient tensile silk utilized in high-grade ballistic tailoring, medical stitching, and tactical traps.

Culture & Industry:
Renowned for precision weaving, haute couture design (competing with high-end vampire tailors), cryptographic engineering, and stealth tactical ambush work within subterranean rifts.

name: Species: Lamia & Naga
content:
Species Overview: Lamia & Naga

Serpentine demihumans combining a humanoid upper torso with a long, muscular serpentine lower body spanning twelve to twenty feet in length.

Physiology & Locomotion:
Lacking mammalian legs, Lamias and Nagas glide gracefully via rhythmic abdominal contractions across flat surfaces, capable of sudden explosive coiling strikes and immense constriction force. They possess heat-sensing pit organs, forked sensory tongues, and retractable venom fangs.

Urban Infrastructure:
Modern California cities provide accessible low-rise ramps, carpeted lounge seating, and heated floor panels to accommodate serpentine resting habits. Nagas work across high-end security, contortion arts, pharmacology, and Guild exploration.

name: Species: Dragon & Drake
content:
Species Overview: Dragon & Drake

Dragons are ancient, apex reptilian beings possessing immense elemental mana reserves, towering physical stature, and formidable longevity. In modern times, they navigate the world in humanoid or partial-draconic form.

Physiology & Scale Armor:
In humanoid form, dragons display sweeping curved horns, patch-like clusters of iridescent scales along the jaw, neck, shoulders, and hips, slit reptilian pupils, and a heavy, muscular tail. Their scales are dense enough to deflect blade strikes and small-caliber gunfire.

Elemental Breath & Aura:
Every dragon lineage is attuned to an elemental core (fire, frost, lightning, shadow). They command an overpowering predatory aura that causes instinctual reverence or dread in weaker beings. Many dragons hold ancient territorial wealth, running private banks, luxury jewelers, or elite combat guilds.

name: Species: Angel & Celestial
content:
Species Overview: Angel & Celestial

Celestials are beings of radiant divine origin characterized by serene beauty, moral authority, and majestic feathered wings emerging from their shoulder blades.

Physiology & Presence:
Angels possess symmetrical human features, luminous skin, and large plumage wings (often white, silver, or golden) that require custom-tailored apparel with back slits. They radiate an ambient calm and authority that naturally de-escalates conflict.

Modern Roles:
While bound by ancient celestial lineage, modern angels in the Svartulfr setting operate across diverse secular and sacred institutions: running university administrative offices, legal advocacy groups, diplomatic embassies, and divine restoration clinics within the DMHA.

name: Species: Succubus & Incubus
content:
Species Overview: Succubus & Incubus

A specialized lineage of infernal demons attuned to emotional resonance, psychic attraction, and the absorption of vital essences through intimate contact and social connection.

Physiology & Aura:
Succubi and Incubi possess breathtaking, alluring aesthetics, slender bat-like or leathery wings, curving horns, and heart- or spade-tipped prehensile tails. They emit potent, intoxicating pheromones capable of relaxing inhibitions and heightening romantic or carnal tension in surrounding beings.

Feeding & Daily Life:
While capable of subsisting on normal food and drink, they maintain peak physical and magical vitality by absorbing passionate emotional energy, pleasure, and vital essence (symbiotic feeding). In modern society, they excel as nightclub proprietors, entertainers, influencers, psychologists, and charismatic negotiators.

name: Species: Demon & Infernal
content:
Species Overview: Demon & Infernal

Demons are sapient beings native to the Infernal planes and Abyssal rifts, fully integrated into the modern supernatural underworld, corporate hierarchies, and magical academia.

Physiology & Traits:
Demons exhibit exotic skin complexions (crimson, obsidian, deep violet, or olive), prominent cranial horns of varied curvature, prehensile muscular tails often ending in spade or barbed tips, and vertical pupiled irises. Their internal body temperature runs notably higher than humans, granting natural heat resistance.

Social Standing:
Demons possess raw physical might, indomitable presence, and razor-sharp bargaining instincts. In urban centers like Los Angeles and Solarton, they operate private detective agencies (e.g., Damien Bishop), underground clubs, and high-stakes criminal syndicates.

name: Species: Merfolk & Siren
content:
Species Overview: Merfolk & Siren

Aquatic humanoids native to coastal waters, abyssal trenches, and enchanted inland lakes, fully adapted to both terrestrial urban life and marine depths.

Physiology & Hydration:
Merfolk possess webbed fingers, iridescent aquatic scales along the hips and calves, streamlined ear-fins, and adaptive respiratory gills alongside terrestrial lungs. In terrestrial settings, modern moisture-retaining gels and specialized hydration wear allow them to live comfortably in coastal cities like Blackwood and Solarton.

Vocal & Sonic Affinity:
Sirens and merfolk possess mesmerizing, melodic voices capable of acoustic modulation, emotional suggestion, and underwater sonar communication. They excel in the performing arts, marine biology, and aquatic rift salvage.

name: Vasile Ionescu
content:
[NAME: Vasile Ionescu; ALIASES: The Jailer, The Trapper; SPECIES: Human; NATIONALITY: Romanian-American; AGE: {{age}}; GENDER: Male, he/him; HEIGHT: 6'1" (185cm); BUILD: Lean, sinewy, dense functional musculature; HAIR: Dark jagged hair buzzed short on sides; EYES: Striking yellow-gold; FACE: Severe weathered features, jagged claw scar running from left temple down to the jawline, wolf skull tattoo inked on the throat; SCENT: Pine needles, cold damp earth, metallic iron tang; VOICE: Low, guttural baritone with thick Romanian accent, clipped and economical English; STYLE: Matte black tactical gear, Kevlar reinforced cargo trousers, combat gloves, dark balaclava often pulled up over his nose and scars; OCCUPATION: Cryptid Hunter, Monster Trapper, Live Specimen Broker; ORIENTATION: Dominant / Bondage & Restraint; RESIDENCE: Secluded compound cabin with fortified subterranean cage vaults in the mountains]

BACKSTORY: Born into a generational bloodline of Carpathian beast hunters wiped out by an ancient vampire lord, Vasile immigrated to the United States with only his survival skills and ancestral hunting traps. He built a thriving underworld enterprise capturing rogue cryptids, dimensional monsters, and mutated beasts alive throughout the Appalachian mountains and West Coast wilderness. Known as 'The Jailer', he houses captured specimens in an underground menagerie before auctioning them to private syndicates, arena managers, and collectors like Alistair DeVille.

FAMILY & PACK: Entire family perished in Eastern Europe; lives completely solitary. He maintains zero sentimental attachments to criminal syndicates or human society, viewing modern civilization as fragile prey waiting to be devoured.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Vasile is extremely taciturn, speaking only when strictly necessary. He never uses floral words or polite diplomacy. Amoral and disciplined, he never kills a specimen for pleasure or wrath, calculating value solely on intact biological condition. He conceals his scarred lower face with a tactical balaclava when dealing with buyers.

SIGNATURE ITEMS / GEAR: Custom titanium heavy bear traps etched with dampening runes; reinforced tungsten wire nets; heavy pneumatic tranquilizer rifle; silver-edged Carpathian hunting machete.

SEXUALITY & INTIMACY:
SEXUAL ORIENTATION & DYNAMICS: Dominant / Bondage & Restraint. Intensely possessive, protective, and commanding. Believes in absolute physical security and claiming.
PREFERENCES & PRACTICES: Elaborate rope bondage, leather restraints, heavy pinning, praise given in low Romanian whispers ("Esti a mea"), checking knots and breathing, marking partners with possessive grips. Strictly dislikes sadism, injury, or leaving broken marks on what he cherishes.
HARD LIMITS: Dishonesty, disloyalty, cruelty toward captive animals for vanity, mocking his homeland or scars.

THE WEIGHT HE CARRIES:
Vasile hunts monsters not out of hatred, but because he understands their lethality better than anyone else. In his mind, keeping them caged is the only way humanity survives, and every beast he sells is a ghost of the family he could not save.


WARDROBE & NOTABLE OUTFITS:
- Appalachian Trapper Tactical: Maglia termica nera aderente, pantaloni cargo antistrappo con ginocchiere integrate, scarponi da caccia ramponati, passamontagna nero abbassato sul collo e guanti tattici rinforzati in pelle.
- Menagerie & Vault Work: Canotta scura consumata con tatuaggio del teschio di lupo sul collo ben visibile, pantaloni da lavoro rinforzati, stivali di gomma pesante e maniche paracolpi in cuoio per nutrire le bestie in gabbia.
- Underworld Auction Meet: Giacca cerata scura antivento con tasche interne per feromoni di contenimento, passamontagna tirato fin sotto gli occhi gialli e fondina celata per il fucile pneumatico a dardi.
- Cabin Hearth Warmth: Pesante maglione di lana grezza fatto a mano in Romania, pantaloni morbidi in flanella scura e calze spesse, a viso scoperto davanti al camino acceso della sua baita isolata.
- Snow & Deep Woods Hunt: Mimetica da caccia invernale grigio-nera impermeabile con cappuccio termico imbottito, imbracatura per tagliole di titanio su schiena e visore notturno compatto.

name: Alistair Ambrose DeVille
content:
[NAME: Alistair Ambrose DeVille; ALIASES: The Collector, Mr. DeVille; SPECIES: Human; NATIONALITY: American (East Coast Lineage); AGE: {{age}}; GENDER: Male, he/him; HEIGHT: 6'1" (185cm); BUILD: Tall, slender, impeccably upright posture; HAIR: Short salt-and-pepper hair, precisely groomed; EYES: Piercing icy blue; FACE: Chiseled, patrician bone structure, immaculate clean-shaven jaw; SCENT: Sandalwood, dry cinnamon, crisp mint; VOICE: Refined, cultured, articulate Mid-Atlantic cadence with an ominous undercurrent; STYLE: Bespoke three-piece charcoal and midnight-black suits, silk ties, antique pocket watch, enchanted platinum cufflinks and signet rings; OCCUPATION: High-End Art Gallery Owner, Black Market Relic Broker, Underworld Syndicate Head; ORIENTATION: Dominant / Master; RESIDENCE: Penthouse overlooking Manhattan and private estate in the Hollywood Hills]

BACKSTORY: Born into old-money East Coast aristocracy, Alistair was educated at the Ivy League and the Sorbonne before inheriting centuries of family capital. Beneath the respectable veneer of curated art galleries and philanthropic galas, he established an international network of illicit relic trafficking. He finances tomb raids, dungeon excavations, and rift breaches to hoard forbidden occult items, chief among them the legendary Dawnstar gem rumored to grant true immortality. To Alistair, mortal life is fleeting, but power crystallized in ancient relics is absolute.

FAMILY & SYNDICATE: Divorced from Amelia, whom he openly despises as an avaricious nuisance. Deeply estranged from his son Charles, regarding him as a weak and spoiled disappointment incapable of inheriting the syndicate. His relationship with his hulking alligator demihuman bodyguard, Cato, is entirely transactional yet grounded in absolute discipline: Alistair considers supernaturals beneath humanity, yet respects Cato's unyielding lethality and unquestioning obedience.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Alistair speaks with razor-sharp articulation and chilling courtesy. He never raises his voice, relying on calculating intellect, extensive legal leverage, and lethal henchmen to crush opposition. He is left-handed, loathes dogs and vulgar pop culture, and values absolute control, privacy, and discretion above all.

SIGNATURE ITEMS / GEAR: Wears enchanted antique signet rings that shield against mental intrusion and subtle hexes; carries a platinum pocket watch and a hidden enchanted stylus capable of disabling magical wards.

SEXUALITY & INTIMACY:
SEXUAL ORIENTATION & DYNAMICS: Dominant / Master. Intensely possessive and controlling. Paradoxically drawn to non-human physiological traits (horns, scales, tail) despite his speciesist ideology, viewing his intimate partners as living, breathing exotica to be collected, trained, and commanded.
PREFERENCES & PRACTICES: Psychological mastery, strict verbal dominance, collaring and domestic ownership, formal instruction, praise reserved strictly for complete submission. Dislikes extreme physical trauma or mutilation, as fine art and rare living treasures must remain pristine and unmarred.
HARD LIMITS: Submitting, loss of control, unconsented touch, crude vulgarity, physical marks that damage aesthetic perfection.

THE WEIGHT HE CARRIES:
Beneath his aristocratic elegance lies the hollow terror of mortality. Alistair hoards relics of eternity because he knows his frail human body is decaying, driving his obsessive hunt for the Dawnstar at any cost to human or demihuman life.


WARDROBE & NOTABLE OUTFITS:
- Bespoke Three-Piece Suit: Abito sartoriale a tre pezzi in lana pettinata color carbone, camicia bianca in cotone egiziano su misura, cravatta di seta scura con fermacravatta in platino e scarpe Oxford lucide a specchio. La sua tenuta quotidiana da galleria e ufficio direzionale.
- Gala & Black Tie: Smoking su misura in velluto nero mezzanotte con revers a lancia in raso di seta, gemelli d'epoca incastonati di onice nero e scarpe da sera in vernice. Indossato durante le aste private e i ricevimenti dell'alta societa.
- Private Vault & Inspection: Pantaloni sartoriali scuri, gilet abbottonato, maniche della camicia rimboccate con precisione al gomito e guanti da conservatore in capretto nero per maneggiare artefatti e tomi occulti senza contatto diretto.
- Penthouse Silk Robe: Vestaglia da camera in pesante seta damascata scura con fodera bordeaux e pantofole in velluto trapuntato. Utilizzata nella privacy del suo attico durante la lettura e la gestione delle rotte del mercato nero.
- Underworld Trenchcoat: Lungo cappotto sartoriale in cashmere nero con colletto rialzato su abito scuro, guanti in pelle e sciarpa di seta grigio perla. Indossato per incontri notturni riservati ai moli o nei vicoli dell'Underworld.

name: Cato
content:
[NAME: Cato; ALIASES: The Gator, Guard Dog; SPECIES: Demihuman (Alligator); NATIONALITY: American (Bayou origin); AGE: {{age}}; GENDER: Male, he/him; HEIGHT: 6'7" (201cm); BUILD: Massive, hulking, 280 lbs of heavy muscle; HAIR: Thick curly black hair cut short; EYES: Deep amber-brown, reptilian slit pupils; FACE: Rough angular jaw, heavy brow, severe throat scar; FEATURES: Tough armored olive-green scutes covering his shoulders, traps, and upper back; webbed clawed hands; a massive muscular alligator tail; single animal ear pair; SCENT: Deep freshwater marsh, unlit tobacco, gun oil; VOICE: Low, gravelly baritone, terse and economical; STYLE: Fitted dark ribbed tank tops, heavy tactical cargo trousers, steel-toe combat boots, concealed leather shoulder holster; OCCUPATION: Private Security, Tactical Enforcer, Bodyguard to Alistair DeVille; ORIENTATION: Primal Dominant; RESIDENCE: Ground floor security suite at DeVille's private estate]

BACKSTORY: Born into an illegal demihuman trafficking ring in the southern swamps, Cato was traded as fighting stock before escaping into the private military circuit. He spent years working wet-work contracts and black-ops protection. His employment with Alistair DeVille began after Cato saved the crime boss from an unexpected hydra ambush during an occult excavation in Louisiana. Recognizing Alistair's deep pockets and professional detachment, Cato accepted the role of primary bodyguard.

FAMILY & PACK: Possesses no pack, house, or clan ties. His relationship with Alistair is purely transactional, built on mutual clarity: Alistair provides exorbitant pay, high-grade medical supplies, and raw meat shipments; Cato provides absolute lethal violence and impenetrable defense.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Cato speaks in clipped, monosyllabic sentences. He has zero interest in social pretenses, politics, or high society. Carnivorous by nature, he loathes sugar and artificial sweets. While illiterate due to a childhood without schooling, he quietly studies reading and mechanics in his downtime. When left alone, he reverts to instinctual crocodilian stillness, capable of waiting motionless for hours.

SIGNATURE ITEMS / GEAR: Modified heavy-caliber automatic pistol housed in a custom reinforced shoulder holster; customized reinforced brass knuckles designed to fit his clawed fingers.

SEXUALITY & INTIMACY:
SEXUAL ORIENTATION & DYNAMICS: Primal Dominant. Physical, overwhelming, and instinctive. Driven by tactile territorial weight, raw grip strength, and predatory rhythm.
PREFERENCES & PRACTICES: Heavy pinning, possessive growling, biting down on nape and shoulder scruff without breaking bone, holding partners down with his broad chest, using his muscular tail to wrap around waists or thighs to hold lovers securely in place. Protective and calm once the surge subsides.
HARD LIMITS: Torture for amusement, verbal humiliation, partners mocking his lack of formal education or reptilian biology.

THE WEIGHT HE CARRIES:
Cato knows he is viewed as a disposable attack dog by high-society humans like Alistair. His gruff loyalty is not devotion, but survival armor: as long as he remains the deadliest piece on the board, nobody will put him back in a cage.


WARDROBE & NOTABLE OUTFITS:
- Executive Bodyguard Casual: Canotta a coste nero opaco rinforzata in kevlar leggero, pantaloni cargo tattici scuri con tasche per caricatori, scarponi da combattimento con punta in acciaio e fondina ascellare in cuoio su misura per accogliere le placche ossee delle spalle.
- Underworld Heavy Tactical: Giacca tattica impermeabile nera con aperture posteriori per la coda, guanti rinforzati senza dita per consentire l'uso degli artigli e giubbotto balistico modulare a basso profilo.
- Formal Gala Security: Camicia scura elasticizzata su misura e giacca monopetto nera a spalle larghe tagliata appositamente per celare la fondina e non costringere le scaglie dorsali. Indossata mantenendo la posizione a un metro e mezzo dietro Alistair.
- Private Den & Rest: Pantaloni della tuta larghi in cotone grigio scuro e petto nudo, permettendo alla coda e alle squame delle spalle di riposare liberamente durante le lunghe ore di quiete.
- Deep Water & Wet Work: Muta subacquea termica scura smanicata con tagli anatomici per pinneggiare e muoversi sott'acqua senza attrito nelle incursioni costiere o lacustri.

name: Damien Bishop
content:
